query: 'SELECT
    CONVERT(INT, FORMAT(f.fecha, 'yyyyMMdd')) AS fecha_key,
    f.fecha AS fecha_completa,
    CAST(YEAR(f.fecha) AS SMALLINT) AS anio,
    CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS trimestre,
    'T' + CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, f.fecha) AS VARCHAR(1)) AS trimestre_nombre,
    CAST(MONTH(f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS mes,
    CASE MONTH(f.fecha)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Enero' WHEN 2 THEN 'Febrero' WHEN 3 THEN 'Marzo' WHEN 4 THEN 'Abril'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Mayo' WHEN 6 THEN 'Junio' WHEN 7 THEN 'Julio' WHEN 8 THEN 'Agosto'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Septiembre' WHEN 10 THEN 'Octubre' WHEN 11 THEN 'Noviembre' WHEN 12 THEN 'Diciembre'
    END AS mes_nombre,
    CASE MONTH(f.fecha)
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Ene' WHEN 2 THEN 'Feb' WHEN 3 THEN 'Mar' WHEN 4 THEN 'Abr'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'May' WHEN 6 THEN 'Jun' WHEN 7 THEN 'Jul' WHEN 8 THEN 'Ago'
        WHEN 9 THEN 'Sep' WHEN 10 THEN 'Oct' WHEN 11 THEN 'Nov' WHEN 12 THEN 'Dic'
    END AS mes_corto,
    CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS semana_anio,
    CAST(DAY(f.fecha) AS TINYINT) AS dia_mes,
    CAST(d.dsn AS TINYINT) AS dia_semana,
    CASE d.dsn
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Lunes' WHEN 2 THEN 'Martes' WHEN 3 THEN 'Miércoles' WHEN 4 THEN 'Jueves'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Viernes' WHEN 6 THEN 'Sábado' WHEN 7 THEN 'Domingo'
    END AS dia_nombre,
    CAST(CASE WHEN d.dsn IN (6, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS es_fin_de_semana
FROM (
    SELECT admission_date AS fecha FROM silver.admissions WHERE admission_date IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT discharge_date FROM silver.admissions WHERE discharge_date IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT payment_date FROM silver.billing WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL
) f
CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT (((DATEPART(WEEKDAY, f.fecha) + @@DATEFIRST - 2) % 7) + 1) AS dsn
) d',
